# core: knowledge index

## Mechanisms by topic

A mechanism filed under two topics is listed under both.

### Files and formats

- [localisation-tokens-packed](mechanisms/localisation-tokens-packed.md): Localisation keys are tokens of up to 10 characters, packed 6 bits each (PLAYED, verified 201602 2026-11-06)
- [ndfbin-round-trip](mechanisms/ndfbin-round-trip.md): Compiled NDF (CNDF ndfbin) decodes and re-encodes byte for byte (PLAYED, verified 201602 2026-11-06)
- [edat-revision-chain](mechanisms/edat-revision-chain.md): Game data is a chain of edat archives, read newest revision first (RE, verified 210942 2026-11-12)

### Loading and crashes

- [load-time-validation-rules](mechanisms/load-time-validation-rules.md): Every object is validated at load, and the first broken rule stops the load (PLAYED, verified 210942 2026-11-12)
- [crash-dump-names-the-error](mechanisms/crash-dump-names-the-error.md): The crash report's dump names the real error (RE, verified 201602 2026-11-03)

### Mod packaging

- [mod-version-and-config-lines](mechanisms/mod-version-and-config-lines.md): A mod is active only with Gen/Version.ndf, and its [Config] hashes mark it outdated after an update (PLAYED, verified 210942 2026-11-12)
- [workshop-upload-folder](mechanisms/workshop-upload-folder.md): The Workshop upload sends the mod folder as it is; a scenario mod needs no generate step (PROBED, verified 210942 2026-11-12)

## Lessons

- [check-against-every-active-mod](lessons/check-against-every-active-mod.md): A build's gates see that build alone; check what must stay unique across every mod active beside it
- [crash-box-hides-the-error](lessons/crash-box-hides-the-error.md): A crash box hides the real error; read the dump before guessing
- [debrief-by-what-the-map-shows](lessons/debrief-by-what-the-map-shows.md): Design probe results to show on the map, and debrief with a few multiple-choice questions about what was seen
- [derive-cross-mod-ids-from-a-hash](lessons/derive-cross-mod-ids-from-a-hash.md): A value that must be unique across every mod a player runs comes from a hash, never a hand pick
- [explicit-zero-is-the-sure-failure](lessons/explicit-zero-is-the-sure-failure.md): Stock leaves required properties out and still loads; only an explicit zero is sure to fail
- [fix-loop-after-a-failed-launch](lessons/fix-loop-after-a-failed-launch.md): After a failed launch, find the root cause, gate it, fix, reinstall hash-checked, and update the play sheet
- [gates-model-the-game-lookup](lessons/gates-model-the-game-lookup.md): A gate checks the data where the game reads it, not just that it exists somewhere
- [one-stall-hides-the-rest](lessons/one-stall-hides-the-rest.md): Put each probe beat in its own parallel branch, so one stall cannot hide the rest
- [prove-each-gate-both-ways](lessons/prove-each-gate-both-ways.md): A gate is proven when it fails the bad build with the game's own words and passes every stock file
- [recorded-recipe-becomes-a-gate](lessons/recorded-recipe-becomes-a-gate.md): A recipe recorded in research must become a gate, or the next generator drops part of it
- [test-the-theory-against-every-observation](lessons/test-the-theory-against-every-observation.md): Before handing over a fix from analysis, test it against every observation, the build that worked included
- [unevaluable-check-fails-until-reviewed](lessons/unevaluable-check-fails-until-reviewed.md): What a gate cannot evaluate fails the build until someone reviews it
